senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Shebuel, proposed as a secondary substitute (כִּינּוּי כִּינּוּי) for שְׁבוּעָה.
units: Ned. 10ᵇ כינויי כינויין דשבועה היכי דמי ש׳ וכ׳ what are secondary substitutes for sh’bu‘ah? Like Sh’buel, Sh’buthiel, Sh’ḳuḳel; ש׳ ש׳ … משמע וכ׳ but could Sh’buel be used, as it may represent the proper noun Shebuel ben Gershom? Say Sh’bubel.
